positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
Main responsibilities include:
Development and design of:
   - Web pages with React.js and React Router v4
   - Back end infrastructure in Node.js
   - RESTful API endpoints with Express.js
   - MongoDB document Schemas with mongoose.js

Other responsibilities include:
   - Writing MongoDB queries
   - Contributing to a growing base of user and developer documentation
   - Contributing to a rapidly evolving web platform
  - (Continuous) refactoring of web platform
   - Act as one of two lead developers who provide guidance and assistance to other team members 
     when necessary

positions.title: Technical Support Specialist
positions.description: Take incoming phone calls from users of Autodesk’s diverse range of software products, identify technical issues, produce a brief summary of the problem and schedule calls with a specialist of the respective product.

positions.title: Data Entry Specialist
positions.description: Peruse through files with records of incoming payments. Manually go over error logs containing transaction bypasses. Investigate why the system couldn’t process these transactions and determine whether or not they ought to be posted into the respective account.
